title: Nonnegative influence entropy
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $I(f)>0$. Then $\sum_i[I_i(f)/I(f)]\log(I(f)/I_i(f))\ge0$, with zero influences contributing zero. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
total influence I[f] is strictly positive
replaced:
If $I[f] > 0$, then the entropy-like quantity attached to the influence distribution
is nonnegative:
\[
  0 \;\le\; \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}{I[f]}\,
    \log\!\left(\frac{I[f]}{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}\right).
\]
